checks: Native content build projection binds the two frozen curves across T1..T5 against independent frozen-row oracles (damage bonus 0.08/0.096/0.112/0.128/0.144 with bIsPercent=true; 10s duration with seconds unit hint), asserts the native description key buff_fork_ThiefCandy_effect, and rejects a group mismatch (character:1052 vs weapon group FOUR) and a flipped bIsPercent unit hint.
Config validation: a proc on weapon:fork_Kite is rejected ('weapon:fork_ThiefCandy'), duration_us 0 is rejected ('positive duration'), a zero-denominator ratio is rejected; a legal config validates.

Runtime trigger: only wearer casts carrying the content-owned ntesim.trigger.critical_dodge tag grant the wearer-only timed buff (id thief_candy.critical_dodge_damage_up, source weapon:fork_ThiefCandy, BuffRecipient::SelfActor, RefreshPolicy::Reset, max 3 stacks); untagged casts grant nothing. Grants run through the real shared gear::on_cast dispatch (thief_candy::on_cast is registered in gear.rs).

Stacking/expiry: each trigger adds one stack up to 3 and resets the 10s duration on a single BuffManager instance; a fourth trigger at the cap refreshes the expiry without adding a stack; the buff expires after the duration and contributes nothing once expired.

Consumer link: the staged damage_bonus modifier is surfaced through get_stat_modifiers_for_actor_with_living_sources — the exact query the damage path (hit/calculation.rs) uses — as 6/25 at 3 stacks, and is absent after expiry.

Independent zone oracles: 2 stacks give M_bonus = 1 + 4/25 = 29/25, rejecting the multiplicative misreading 729/625; 3 stacks (cap) give 31/25, rejecting (27/25)^3 = 19683/15625. The per-stack fraction 2/25 and tier values are read from CT_ForkBuff rows, not from the implementation.

Focused run: 10/10 thief_candy tests pass (8 pre-existing + thief_candy_buff_surfaces_damage_bonus_through_damage_path_query + thief_candy_additive_zone_rejects_multiplicative_misreading). rustfmt clean on the touched test file; clippy clean for ntesim-content tests.
Web scenario web/tests/combat/thief_candy.mjs is authored and registered in web/tests/weapon_passives.test.mjs for CI; WASM is not built in this Linux env, so the web test was not executed here.

combat_scope: Projection of the frozen T1..T5 damage-bonus ratios (0.08/0.096/0.112/0.128/0.144) and 10s duration into a wearer-only timed buff that stages a damage_bonus stat modifier. Trigger, grant, stacking, refresh and expiry execute through the real shared gear::on_cast dispatch and BuffManager; the staged modifier is consumed by the real damage path (hit/calculation.rs reads the same buff-stats query and adds it into the additive M_bonus zone). The Critical Dodge trigger itself is a content-owned scenario tag and can never be declared through a real scenario run: the research action_gameplay_tags pipeline rejects non-native tags and the engine does not model Critical Dodge (admission Q1-V3 exclusion).
independent_oracles: T5 per-stack fraction: buff_ThiefCandy_Up key 5 = 0.144 = 18/125, duration buff_ThiefCandy_CD = 10.0s constant across keys. (thief_candy_projection_binds_five_refinement_tiers)
Zone math, 2 stacks: M_bonus = 1 + 4/25 = 29/25 = 1.16; the multiplicative misreading 1.08^2 = 729/625 = 1.1664 is rejected. (thief_candy_additive_zone_rejects_multiplicative_misreading)
Zone math, 3-stack cap: M_bonus = 1 + 6/25 = 31/25 = 1.24; the multiplicative misreading (27/25)^3 = 19683/15625 = 1.259712 is rejected. (thief_candy_additive_zone_rejects_multiplicative_misreading)

Consumer query: 3 staged stacks surface damage_bonus = 6/25 through get_stat_modifiers_for_actor_with_living_sources, the exact query hit/calculation.rs uses; nothing surfaces after expiry. (thief_candy_buff_surfaces_damage_bonus_through_damage_path_query)
known_gaps: Critical Dodge has no native engine trigger; the content-owned tag ntesim.trigger.critical_dodge is an explicit scenario-level declaration, with a return condition to replace it when the engine models dodges natively.

The research action_gameplay_tags pipeline rejects non-native tags, so the dodge tag cannot be declared through scenario metadata in a real scenario run; trigger tests construct ActionMetadata directly.
The 10s duration is read from buff_ThiefCandy_CD as seconds per the {1}s description placeholder; no independent in-game timing evidence.
Web tests were authored and registered but not executed here: no WASM build exists in this Linux environment; they are written for CI.
name: Thief's Candy

passive_description.localized: Increases wearer's damage by <lv>{0}</> for <lv>{1}</>s after performing a Critical Dodge, up to <lv>3</> stacks. Resets the duration when triggered again.
passive_description.source: 装备者每次极限闪避后自身造成的伤害提高<lv>{0}</>，持续<lv>{1}</>秒，最多叠加<lv>3</>层，重复触发刷新持续时间。

tested_hypotheses: Only actions carrying the content-owned ntesim.trigger.critical_dodge tag grant the buff; untagged actions grant nothing.

Critical Dodge is not modeled by the engine, so the tag is an explicit scenario-level declaration of the trigger, never a silent zero and never an invented native trigger; return condition: replace the tag check when the engine models dodges natively.
Each trigger adds one stack up to a cap of 3 and resets the 10s duration on a single BuffManager instance (RefreshPolicy::Reset).
A trigger at the 3-stack cap refreshes the duration without adding a fourth stack.
The buff expires after the duration and contributes nothing once expired.
The damage bonus joins the additive M_bonus zone: two stacks give exactly 29/25, three give 31/25; multiplicative misreadings (729/625, 19683/15625) are rejected.
The staged damage_bonus modifier reaches the damage path: the buff-stats query hit/calculation.rs uses returns 6/25 at 3 stacks.
The +8%/+9.6%/+11.2%/+12.8%/+14.4% values and 10s duration are bound from CT_ForkBuff through the refinement DataList with bIsPercent unit checks.
Global release availability remains unverified in the frozen catalog.
